name: Lime Technologies AB (publ)
summary: Lime Technologies AB (publ) software as a service (SaaS) based customer relationship management (CRM) solutions in the Nordic region. It engages in development, distribution, and sale of CRM systems and other customer management platforms, as well as offers consulting services. The company also provides Lime CRM, an industry-specific solution; Lime Go, a sales solution; Lime Connect; and Lime Intenz that includes change management, sales training, customer care, and customized solutions. It offers CRM solutions for utility, real estate, membership, wholesale, manufacturing and industry, consulting, machinery, construction, and sports companies. The company was formerly known as Lundalogik AB…
